name: codeontic
description: 受本体论启发的行为建模引擎：把「系统应该怎么运转」写成机器可校验的模型并绑定到真实代码，每次 PR 零 LLM 对账，防止实现与认知漂移。
//files: Ship the dist engine only; seeds/examples/research/docs are excluded so the published package carries no target-repo internals. .tsbuildinfo lives inside dist (see tsconfig.build.json) and is build state, not shipped code.

scripts.//prepublishOnly: npm publish packs whatever dist/ holds and runs no build of its own. Kept even though `release` does the same work first: this fires on any publish path, including one that never goes through `release`.
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run build:clean && pnpm run verify:dist
scripts.//release: Repeats build+verify rather than leaning on prepublishOnly alone — a lifecycle hook is skippable (--ignore-scripts, a publisher that bypasses it), and the thing it guards is unpublishable once wrong.
scripts.release: pnpm run build:clean && pnpm run verify:dist && changeset publish
scripts.//release:version: changeset rewrites package.json with its own formatter, which disagrees with biome's — so the version bump lands lint-dirty and CI fails on the release PR it just opened. Formatting lives here rather than only in the workflow because a local `changeset version` produces the same broken commit. The trailing `lint` is the actual guarantee: it covers whatever else changesets touched, not just the file we thought to format.
scripts.release:version: changeset version && biome check --write package.json && pnpm run lint
